Definition: from G2323; attendance (specially, medical, i.e. cure); figuratively and collectively, domestics:--healing, household.
BiblicalUsage: therapeía is the word the Bible uses when it means healing, attendance, household. In Luke 9:11, healed them that had need of healing, and it appears again in Revelation 22:2.
TheologicalSignificance: Leaves of the tree given for the healing of the nations make me look forward to a day when no one I love is sick any more.
